name: Los Huertos (Spain)
description: Square green flag with a blue band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Los Huertos (quartered, a fountain, the aqueduct, a plant and a lion).
history: Los Huertos adopted its arms and flag officially on 27 April 1999, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 24 November 1999; the flag is square, of proportion 1:1, green with a blue bend and the municipal arms in its colours.

features.role: band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
